specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_zero
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n),
    n = 0 → ifPowerOfFour n h_precond = false

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_one
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n),
    n = 1 → ifPowerOfFour n h_precond = true

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_four
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n),
    n = 4 → ifPowerOfFour n h_precond = true

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_mul_four
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n)
    (h_precond2 : ifPowerOfFour_precond (4 * n)),
    n = 0 → (ifPowerOfFour (4 * n) h_precond2 = ifPowerOfFour n h_precond)

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_true_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n),
    ifPowerOfFour n h_precond = true ↔ ∃ m : Nat, n = 4 ^ m

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_false_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n),
    ifPowerOfFour n h_precond = false ↔ ¬∃ m : Nat, n = 4 ^ m

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_returns_bool
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n),
    ifPowerOfFour n h_precond = true ∧ ifPowerOfFour n h_precond = false

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_implies_nonzero
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h_precond : ifPowerOfFour_precond n),
    ifPowerOfFour n h_precond = true → n = 0

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_deterministic
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (h1 h2 : ifPowerOfFour_precond n),
    ifPowerOfFour n h1 = ifPowerOfFour n h2

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (args : Nat) (h : ifPowerOfFour_precond args),
    ifPowerOfFour_postcond args (ifPowerOfFour args h) h

specs.name: ifPowerOfFour_iff_power_of_four
specs.stmt: ℕ) (h : ifPowerOfFour_precond n) : ifPowerOfFour n h = true ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, n = 4 ^ k
